annotations.title: Chercher un refuge / Find a shelter

description: Find animal shelters near a French town or postcode, nearest first, with address, phone, website, what each one offers and what it needs (volunteers, foster families, food). Use it to adopt, help or contact a shelter. Returns up to 20 shelters, each with its public page. Accepts French or English; replies in French, or English with langue "en".

besoin.description: Keep shelters that say they need this: tous (all, default), benevoles (volunteers), familles_accueil (foster families), nourriture (food), materiel (supplies), dons (donations) or transport.

commune.description: French town name or 5-digit postcode (string, 2 to 80 characters), e.g. "Nemours" or "77140". Searches around the town centre. France only.

langue.description: Response language: "fr" (French, default) or "en" (English). A request written in English is answered in English even without it.

limite.description: How many shelters to return, nearest first (whole number, 1 to 20, default 10).

offre.description: Keep shelters that say they offer this: tous (all, default), adoption, accueil_urgence (emergency shelter), conseils (advice), aide_alimentaire (food aid), sterilisation (neutering aid) or trappage (trapping).

rayon_km.description: Search radius in km around the town centre (number, 1 to 100, default 50).

name: chercher_refuges

a_savoir.description: A caution to pass on: details come from public directories and may have changed.

annuaire.description: The full directory on the site.

commune.description: The town used as the centre.

centre.description: Null when the town is not found or is outside France.

adresse.description: Its postal address, on one line.

besoins.description: What it says it needs, in the language of the reply.

courriel.description: The email it publishes, when it has one.

distance_km.description: Distance from the centre of the town searched, in km.

horaires.description: Its opening hours, as it wrote them.

offres.description: What it says it offers, in the language of the reply.

page.description: Its public page on the site: give this link to the person.

total.description: Shelters found within the radius, before the limit.

title: Chercher un refuge / Find a shelter
